segments.text: Okay so I'm looking at the todo script today and there are a couple of things I want to get done.

First one, the list command just prints plain text lines. I want a dash dash json flag on list so that other tools can parse it, like one JSON object per line with the id, the text and whether it's done.
Keep the plain text output exactly as it is when the flag isn't passed, I use that all the time.
Second thing, adding a todo with spaces in it is broken. If I run todo add fix the login bug it only saves the word fix. It should take everything after add as the text.
That's a real bug, people hit it all the time, let's fix that today.
Yeah I hit that yesterday. Also, unrelated, did you see the game last night?
Ha, no, I was heads down. Anyway.
One more small thing, the readme doesn't mention the done command at all. Let's document it, just a short section with an example.
And I think that's it for this one. Let's ship the JSON flag first, that unblocks the dashboard.
